CustomObject.description: Per-org settings for the QuickBooks Online webhook: the verifier token Intuit signs webhooks with, the QuickBooks company (realm) id webhooks must come from, and an on/off switch. A PROTECTED CUSTOM SETTING, not Custom Metadata, so the token is data entered in each org and never enters source control (same reasoning as Webhook Config). JSI-121 / Jason Ott.
CustomObject.label: QuickBooks Settings
